nfrBudgets.scalability: Draft baseline: horizontal scale verification at approved peak x2
nfrBudgets.retention: workforce-and-candidate-data, tenant-business-data, audit-metadata, configuration-data sınıfları için jurisdiction policy, legal hold, deletion ve restore kanıtı zorunludur
